Welcome to Crocodile Kruger Safari Lodge
Firstly aptly situated on the banks of the Crocodile River is our Crocodile Kruger Safari Lodge, overlooking the Kruger National Park, offering both the leisure and corporate client a gateway to the regions many tourist attractions. In addition to the professional big 5 game viewing experiences on offer in the Kruger National Park, the Safari Lodge is uniquely positioned to certainly further afford its visitors the opportunity to experience day trips to the Panorama Route, Swaziland and Mozambique.
Further more the double storey thatch roofed lodge offers six luxury en-suite, air-conditioned double bedrooms with sleeperwood furniture.
In addition each room at Crocodile Kruger Safari Lodge offers a view of the river and bushveld which breathes rest and comfort. Our lower deck accommodates a dining area where breakfast can be enjoyed while overlooking the swimming pool. The upper verandah is equipped with comfortable chairs and a bar for the thirsty. With spectacular views overlooking the river and Kruger National Park above all. In conclusion dining at night takes place under the stars in summer or next to an open fire on the chilly winter nights for instance.

The Lodge
General Lodge Description
Crocodile Kruger Safari Lodge is located in a nature reserve on the banks of the Crocodile River. With stunning views of the Kruger National park and its wildlife. The lodge is located only one hour drive from the Kruger Mpumalanga International Airport. Just about 20 minutes from the nearest entrance gate into the world famous Kruger National park .
Accommodation options at this four star lodge includes 6 en-suite air-conditioned double/twin rooms, a two bed and a six bed self-serve unit. The luxury rooms can be booked on a dinner bed and breakfast basis. Meals served outdoors under the African sky on the pool deck with the sound of lions from the Kruger Park. As well as the Hippos from the Crocodile River as background entertainment.
The Crocodile Kruger now also has exciting boma evenings where the true spirit of Africa can be experienced. Therefore guests can enjoy true African friendliness and cuisine in our boma to the rhythm of African drums.
Guests of Crocodile Kruger Safari are invited to join us on open vehicle game drives accompanied by an expert guide in the world-famous Kruger National. Observe wildlife from close because self drive options are available with ease from the lodge due to its close presence to both Malelane and Crocodile Bridge entrance gates to the Kruger Park. Overnight Kruger safaris are also available from the lodge along with various other trips to the regions many tourist attractions.
Bring your mountain bike (Also available to rent at the lodge) and enjoy the easy routes along the river banks or into the bush where wild animals can be seen for a memorable experience. A bush walk within the reserve brings your soul close to nature.
